title: Distributed Systems Classics (2017)
summary: A curated reading list of classic papers and resources for learning distributed systems fundamentals, covering consensus algorithms, consistency models, and fault tolerance concepts essential for building scalable distributed applications.
problem_solved: Provides a structured learning path for developers to master distributed systems concepts that are critical for building reliable, scalable modern infrastructure.
why_valuable: Distributed systems theory is notoriously difficult to self-learn; this curated list offers a proven roadmap to understand foundational concepts like consensus, replication, and fault tolerance.
